observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with a black air intake box attached.
The air intake box has 'GDI' and 'TDC' printed on it.
The engine is surrounded by various hoses and mechanical components.
The background shows other engines, suggesting a workshop or scrap yard environment.
There is a watermark 'TIWAKO EZE' across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may be a different model than the one claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine model code stamped on the engine block or the air intake box.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest value engine of this type

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage or seized components.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running and turning over.

risks.risk: Missing essential engine components like the alternator, water pump, or starter.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included engine accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine model code stamped on the engine block.
Photo of the engine number (VIN) stamped on the block.
Video of the engine running to confirm it is not seized.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
